learning.title: A test poll that reads the worker state treats WORKER_STATE_LOCKED as not yet
learning.trigger: waitForCondition calls registrationStore.load() while the supervisor under test holds the state lock.
learning.mistake: The read waits out the 1s lock budget on a loaded host and throws WORKER_STATE_LOCKED, ending the wait with an unrelated error (released event spool data replays exactly after restart, 1 of 10 runs at load 33).
learning.rule: waitForCondition (tests/helpers/worker-execution/recovery-support.ts) reads again after exactly that error and still ends at its own deadline, with the lock error as the cause only if the last read was still locked; any other error ends the wait.

verification.requirement: tests/unit/wait-for-condition_test.ts holds the real state lock past its 1s budget: it fails 3 of 4 before the change and passes after.
